mission: Help prospective tiny-home buyers make safer, source-backed placement and cost decisions without overstating legal certainty.
release_policy: Standing authorization granted 2026-07-17 for exact-path, independently reviewed, QA-green pushes and GitHub Pages deployments. Verify the pushed SHA and action-specific production invariants; stop on divergence or ambiguous rollback scope.

scheduled_execution.objective: Improve human value recursively by connecting one real user question to domain evidence, SEO evidence, at most one useful action, feedback, and durable learning.
scheduled_execution.self_improvement_boundary: Change prompts, tests, or protocol only from a concrete failure, reviewer finding, or repeated friction; cadence alone does not justify process work.
scheduled_execution.no_op_condition: No repository divergence, new evidence, due sensor, active/ready action, or due bounded research question with satisfied gates.

local_dependencies.name: semrush
local_dependencies.fallback: Continue without Semrush and label the evidence unavailable or stale.
